title: Windows: Update GLib to 2.66.4.
description:
Upgrade our vcpkg bundle to one that includes GLib 2.66.4 and libxml2
2.9.10.

Avoid running pkgconfig on Windows so that we don't find Strawberry
Perl's headers.
